budget.counts: cost pilot + every child + failures + verification
budget.gpu: none unless in the authorised cost design; not used

architecture.fusion_sequence: Concatenate(channels) -> Conv1D(16,3,causal) core -> last position -> Dense(p)
architecture.fusion_summary: GlobalAveragePooling1D per branch -> Concatenate -> Dense(32) core -> Dense(p)

optimizer.ml07_diagnostic: plain ReLU stack + mae + lr 1e-3 + 3000 updates stayed at the naive level (val MASE 0.49 vs naive 0.50, linear 48x8 reference 0.43); residual TCN blocks with ELU + mse + lr 3e-3 + 6000 updates + patience 30 reach 0.43-0.46 on 3/3 seeds (relu at lr 1e-2 collapsed on 3/3); metrics reported are MAE/MASE, the optimisation loss is mse
optimizer.tuning_allowance: NONE after the ML07 instrument diagnostic (sealed before any pilot cell)

architecture.why: widths follow the proposal's illustration scaled down for CPU; every width is a sensitivity alternative, not an optimum

context.why: W = 48 = 2 cycles of P_A and 0.80 cycles of P_B at h = 3; covers tau and the branch receptive field

controls.adverse: a shuffled-time control is NOT used as the r = 0 arm
controls.grouping_positive: profile grouping recovers the latent groups at h >= 2 (ARI = 1) and not at h = 0
controls.positive_learning: the modular model must beat the naive forecaster and approach the causal oracle on the development split at h = 3, r = 1 (ML07); measured with the real receiver

cross_dependence.r0_construction: the lagged partner term is replaced by an independent N(0,1) draw scaled to the same variance; marginals preserved in distribution (ML04 checks variance, ACF and quantiles across replicates); no temporal shuffle
cross_dependence.why: tau = 3 < window and > horizon: the dependence is causal and inside the context; beta = 0.8 gives the oracle a visible gain over the marginal oracle (smoke: cross-correlation 0.68 at lag tau under r = 1 vs 0.00 under r = 0, marginal variance equal within 4 %)

estimands.H2: e(h) = MASE(profiles, h) - MASE(random, h), averaged over replicates and the predefined random assignments; slope of e over h by least squares with equal weights
estimands.H3: d_r = MASE(sequence, r) - MASE(summary, r); gamma = d_1 - d_0
estimands.sign: negative favours the method; no margin applied in the pilot; the pilot reports precision, not support

heterogeneity_levels.control: level 0 is the internal null of H2: e(0) has no mechanism to favour profiles
heterogeneity_levels.why: h scales BOTH persistence gap (0.24 h) and period gap (50 % h) so that level 0 is a homogeneous population (grouping arbitrary by construction) and level 3 separates groups by profile alone; amplitude, sampling, p, N and noise are constant across h (H2 rule)

horizon.why: one step, direct, per variable (multi-output head); multi-step is E1 work

derivations.information_not_seen: latent group labels, generator parameters, thetas, the oracle and the future are never inputs

mase.denominator: train MAE of the seasonal naive with the variable's declared period; shared by every arm
mase.zero_policy: a zero denominator (deterministic clean control) is NO_APLICA before any test score; MAE reported

period_A.sensitivity: declared, not run in this pilot
period_A.why: P_A = 24 samples gives 86 cycles in training and 2 cycles in the context; small enough for many cycles, large enough for the detector's receptive field (17) to see a fraction of a cycle

derivations.precision_rule: the pilot's replicate SD of e(h), d_r and gamma feeds a simulation-based sample-size rule for E0-CONF (bootstrap over replicates); not claimed confirmatory

sampling.unit: 1 sample = 1 time step of the generator; all variables share the interval
sampling.why: H2 forbids changing sampling or volume across levels; a common grid keeps information equal

volume.why: purge = W + H derived from the consumed support; windows are overlapping (not independent replicates); independence comes from replicates (generator seeds), not from windows, seeds of the optimiser or origins

reserve: not generated, not opened: E0-CONF uses distinct generator parameter ranges and seeds fixed later

review_table.obligation: generator reproduces equations, population and distribution; labels/metadata/latent group never features
future/validation/test changes leave fit, groups and past outputs unchanged; roles by identity/time
H2 changes the assignment, not names; sizes, models, contexts, budget equal per arm
H3 preserves marginals in distribution and changes the relevant dependence; no shuffle control
H3 arms use identical frozen extractor activations; freezing verified by weights
group -> detector/integrator/adapter -> fusion -> core/head keeps temporal shape; real gradients
positive learning with the real receiver; oracle and naive references; curves distinguish lack of training from lack of utility
early stopping by validation, real weight restore, reload parity, test never selects
metrics from arrays; shared denominators; zero policy; empty/non-finite refuse
e(h), d0/d1/gamma with the declared sign; replicates/seeds/windows never inflate the unit
child reads delivered bytes; CPU updates observed; complete costs and limits
a real failure leaves a terminal/outbox; reconciliation by population and content
